create_DINOHead: create a DINOHead module with configurable MLP layers and weight-normalized last layer for self-supervised learning
build_DINOHead_with_batchnorm: build a DINOHead with batch normalization enabled in the MLP for improved training stability
run_DINOHead_forward: run a forward pass through DINOHead to project features and normalize before the last layer
build_MLP_with_build_mlp: build an MLP network with configurable layers, hidden dimensions, and optional batch normalization using _build_mlp
review_DINOHead_init_weights: review the DINOHead weight initialization using truncated normal distribution with std 0.02
